_comment: OpenAIO-Whoop stackup: NextPCB library 6L-1.0mm-0.5oz-1080 (nextpcb.com/impedance-control-stackups, read 2026-10-11) built as HDI 1+4+1 (laser L1-L2 and L5-L6 through the 1080, buried L2-L5 through the core / 2313 / core sub-lamination). Library dielectrics: 1080 0.077 / core 0.30 H/H / 2313 0.103 / core 0.30 H/H / 1080 0.077; the library core thickness includes its 0.5 oz copper, so each core dielectric is 0.265 here. Outer 1 oz finished, inner 0.5 oz, Dk 4.2. 6L HDI is a library entry only from 1.2 mm, so 1+4+1 at 1.0 mm is an engineered build on these dielectrics (NextPCB confirmation open). Applied by setup_board.py (also readable by apply_stackup.py).
